How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Gargi College Delhi Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Gargi College Delhi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Gargi College Delhi Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Guest Faculty posts at Gargi College Delhi is 16-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies for the Guest Faculty (Commerce) position at Gargi College Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for Gargi College Delhi Guest Faculty recruitment is strictly online.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria for the Guest Faculty post are as per the norms set by UGC and the University of Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Faculty positions at Gargi College Delhi is scheduled for 17-08-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the official website of Gargi College Delhi?
faq.answer: The official website of Gargi College Delhi is www.gargicollege.in.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty roles?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The Guest Faculty positions at Gargi College Delhi are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the detailed official notification?
faq.answer: The detailed official notification can be accessed through the 'Official Notification PDF' link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
